caption: The drawing features a single, prominently displayed, round glass bottle with a narrow neck and a small handle attached to the neck and shoulder. The bottle is rendered in dark, translucent brown with reflective highlights and visible scratches or marks on its surface, suggesting reflections and wear. The bottle rests on a light, slightly yellowish shadow, indicating its placement on a flat surface. In the upper left corner, there is an inset line drawing of the same bottle, showing its outline and proportions without any shading or color. Both the colored rendering and the line drawing are enclosed within thin, rectangular borders, and measurement scales are noted below each version: "3/4'' = 1'" for the colored drawing and "1/2'' = 1'" for the line drawing. The artist's signature, "A. Walbeck," appears in the lower right corner. The background of the entire piece is a plain, off-white or beige color.
title: Bottle
